# 3. sampling weightの年次補正
```{r}
# ================================================================================
# 2. sampling weightの年次補正
# ================================================================================
# 年ごとの元 v005 合計を算出

year_totals <- all_data_merged %>%
  dplyr::group_by(year) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(total_v005 = sum(v005, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop')

# Survey designオブジェクトの作成前に変数を変換
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  mutate(
    v021 = as.numeric(v021),
    # Primary Sampling Unit
    v022 = as.character(haven::as_factor(v022))
    #haven_labelledをfactorに変換してからcharacter
  )

# 正規化済みサンプリングウェイトの作成
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  dplyr::select(-any_of(c("total_v005"))) %>% # 存在する場合のみ削除
  dplyr::left_join(year_totals, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    # 元のDHSウェイト
    dhs_weight = v005 / 1e6,
    # 年次正規化係数：全期間対象の標本サイズ比 (例：年の全体ウェイト比)
    year_norm = total_v005 / sum(year_totals$total_v005),
    # 正規化済みウェイト
    sampling_weight_norm = dhs_weight / year_norm,
    # 極端値トリミング
    sampling_weight_trimmed = pmax(
      pmin(sampling_weight_norm,
           quantile(sampling_weight_norm, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)),
      quantile(sampling_weight_norm, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-dhs_weight, -year_norm, -total_v005, -treatment_start)  # 中間変数は削除

label04 <- attributes(all_data_merged$dm_child_age_month)$labels


# 1. v021, v022, sampling_weight_trimmedのいずれかがNAの行を削除
all_data_merged <- all_data_merged %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(v021) & !is.na(v022) & !is.na(sampling_weight_trimmed))

# 2
```

# 4. ダミー変数化
```{r}
# ******************************************************************************
#' @title ダミー変数化のための関数定義
#' @description
#' - haven_labelled クラスの変数を対象に、labels 属性を利用して
#'   ダミー変数を生成する関数
#' @param df データフレーム
#' @param reference_drop ダミー化の際に最初のレベルを除くかどうか（多重共線性対策）
#' @return ダミー変数化されたデータフレーム
#'  作成日：2024/06/10
#'  作成者：仲田俊一
#' ------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
dummify_labelled <- function(df, reference_drop = FALSE) {
  target_cols <- names(df)
  target_cols <- target_cols[grepl("^[a-zA-Z]{2}_", target_cols)]

  cat_vars <- target_cols[purrr::map_lgl(target_cols, ~ {
    x <- df[[.x]]
    haven::is.labelled(x) && !is.null(attr(x, "labels"))
  })]

  for (v in cat_vars) {
    x <- df[[v]]
    labs <- attr(x, "labels")

    if (is.null(labs) || length(labs) == 0) next

    levels_to_dummy <- if (reference_drop) labs[-1] else labs

    if (length(levels_to_dummy) == 0) {
      df[[v]] <- NULL
      next
    }

    for (i in seq_along(levels_to_dummy)) {
      code <- unname(levels_to_dummy[i])
      lbl  <- names(levels_to_dummy)[i]

      lbl_clean <- gsub("[^[:alnum:]_]", "_", lbl)
      lbl_clean <- gsub("_{2,}", "_", lbl_clean)
      lbl_clean <- gsub("^_|_$", "", lbl_clean)

      new_col <- paste0(v, "__", lbl_clean)
      df[[new_col]] <- as.integer(unclass(x) == code)

      var_lab <- attr(x, "label")
      if (is.null(var_lab) || length(var_lab) == 0) var_lab <- v
      attr(df[[new_col]], "label") <- paste0(var_lab, " (", lbl, ")")
    }

    df[[v]] <- NULL
  }

  df
}
#' --------関数ここまで-------------------------------------------------------------

# 2. factor変数をダミー化
all_data_merged_dummy <- dummify_labelled(
  all_data_merged, reference_drop = FALSE)

```


# 5. 追加変数の作成(複数のダミー変数を一つにまとめる)
```{r}
all_data_merged_dummy <- all_data_merged_dummy %>%
  mutate(
    rh_del_stay_appropriate = case_when(
      rh_del_stay__1_2_days == 1 | rh_del_stay__3_days == 1 ~ 1,
      rh_del_stay__1_2_days == 0 & rh_del_stay__3_days == 0 ~ 0,
      rh_del_stay__12_23_hours == 1 | 
        rh_del_stay__6_11_hours == 1 | rh_del_stay__6_hours == 1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    dm_age_of_hh_head_younger = case_when(
      dm_age_of_hh_head__10s == 1 ~ 1,
      dm_age_of_hh_head__20s == 1 ~ 1,
      dm_age_of_hh_head__30s == 1 ~ 1,
      dm_age_of_hh_head__40s == 1 ~ 1,
      dm_age_of_hh_head__50s == 1 ~ 0,
      dm_age_of_hh_head__60s == 1 ~ 0,
      dm_age_of_hh_head__70s == 1 ~ 0,
      dm_age_of_hh_head__80 == 1 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  ) 

attr(all_data_merged_dummy$rh_del_stay_appropriate, "label") <-
```
